about: Variable-resolution hex cases for testing and benchmarking (tools/hex_varres.py). Each regional case is `woof hex regional` arguments: a fine core graded over several doublings inside the cut (--ring-factor/--transition-factor/--cull-pad-scale) or refined by a terrain density raster (`woof hex density --terrain-gradient`, painted with the ladder by --density-raster). Each names a reference: the same region on a quasi-uniform fine mesh and on a coarse mesh, so transition-band diagnostics read against meshes without the transition. The global case is `woof hex mesh-plan --global-mesh` (the MPAS v8.4.2 suite route, R2). Coordinates only; no site data.
